[h3][b]This DLC adds “Ultraman & Emi” from [i]Ultraman: Rising[/i] to the game, featuring iconic abilities from the animated feature film, and a unique skillset that combines Ultraman and the newborn kaiju, Emi as 1 character.[/b][/h3]

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdjZqYXN3emp5bG5jb3J3N3NzN3ZxcjFjYmx2b2djcDU3N2Jkems2NSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/5FAHO5WX9rWw57mwwQ/giphy.gif[/img]

[h2]Big Hero, bigger responsibilities![/h2]
As Ultraman, you are star athlete Ken Sato, who returns home reluctantly to assume his father’s Ultraman legacy. But things quickly get complicated when he finds himself raising a newborn Kaiju, whom he names Emi. Like all infants, she’s curious yet temperamental, sweet yet demanding; even her cries are like weaponized tantrums. Play as this unlikely duo and unleash powerful (and sometimes unintentional) combos on your foes while struggling to play the role of a surrogate father.

With this latest DLC, alongside previous crossover characters from Ultraman and other Tokusatsu legends, GigaBash now features a massive lineup of [b]23 playable characters[/b].

[i][b]So, will you rise to the challenge and discover what it means to be Ultraman? [/b][/i]

[h3]Get the dynamic duo now with the [b]GigaBash | Ultraman: Rising DLC[/b]！ːsteamhappyː  [/h3]

[b]Enter the GigaBash arena as King Ghidorah and Hedorah to challenge Godzilla in the ultimate Kaiju showdown. Both characters boast a unique skillset and playstyle inspired by iconic moments as seen in their films.[/b][/i]

notes.title: Patch 1.3: Replay Feature (Beta) & Crossplay Update
notes.content:
[h2]Replay Feature (BETA)[/h2]

To help you capture the Kaiju fantasy of your dreams, we’ve released the Beta of Replay Feature. This new feature allows you to save and watch battle replays from within the game. Use the [b]Free Camera Mode[/b] to move the camera down to a pedestrian’s point of view and feel the terrifying scale of destruction. You can also apply various nostalgic camera filters or use the new [b]News Channel filter[/b] for an extra cinematic twist. ːsteamhappyː

This feature is still in Beta and is only available in [b]Local Play[/b] for now, but it will be available for online mode in the future. As this feature is still an early work in progress, we would like to involve our community in its development. Let us know your valuable feedback on our [url=discord.gg/gigabash][b]Discord[/b][/url], and let’s discuss how to further improve this feature!

[previewyoutube=5zNGhzzvJFU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Cross-Platform Matchmaking & Online Mode updates[/h2]

Assert your dominance online with this new update! All platforms now share the same public matchmaking pool via [b]Public Match[/b]. That means you’ll be able to battle against Nintendo Switch, Xbox, PlayStation, and Epic players when you search for a Public Match. However, players will not be able to directly invite their friends from another platform via Private Match.

[h3]This is a free update available to all players with the base game.[/h3] So hurry up and update your GigaBash to the latest version to enjoy these new features!

The ultimate kaiju crossover is here! New DLC Adds [b]4 playable characters[/b] from the Godzilla universe: [b]Godzilla, Gigan, Mechagodzilla, and Destoroyah[/b]!

Reenact the final battle between Godzilla vs. Destoroyah or play as your favorite GigaBash character and test your mettle against the OGs of the Tokusatsu genre. https://store.steampowered.com/app/2161720/GigaBash__Godzilla_4_Kaiju_Pack/

[h1][b]Patch Note 1.1[/b][/h1]
The following updates are free and available for all GigaBash players.

[h3]Onslaught Mode[/h3]
Play [b]Solo or Co-op[/b] with another friend in [b]Couch Play[/b] as you battle against an endless wave of enemies. Acquire buffs as you progress and break the record for the highest number of waves cleared on the global leaderboard. You will also be rewarded with [b]unique skins[/b] only unlockable through this mode as you clear a certain wave number.

[h3]Arcade Mode[/h3]
Test your mastery of your favorite characters! Challenge yourself against [b]8 random Ai-controlled enemies[/b] with increasing difficulty and solidify your rank by defeating the Final Boss. Do you have what it takes to beat ‘em all?

[h3]Mayhem Online[/h3]
You asked, we delivered! By popular request, players can now enjoy Mayhem mode online via [b]Private Match[/b]. Invite your friends and indulge in this wacky collection of minigames together.

[h3]Cross-Platform Matchmaking & Online Mode Updates[/h3]
We have upgraded our Crossplay feature! Now, players from all platforms ([i]PlayStation®4, PlayStation®5, Steam, Epic Games Store[/i]) share the same public matchmaking pool via [b]Public Match[/b]. However, players will not be able to invite their friends from another platform via Private Match. We’ve also added an [b]Emote Menu[/b] in the Online Mode so players can have some fun with GigaBash emojis while they wait for other players to be ready for battle.

notes.title: We did it! GigaBash is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[h2]Today is the day we can finally release our kaiju brawler GigaBash! ːsteamhappyː[/h2]

This game is the product of a lot of time, hard work and love from the Passion Republic Team. We’d like to salute everyone who’s helped us make our ambitions into a reality. Without the constant support of our family, friends and fans, GigaBash wouldn’t exist. Thank you so much everyone!

###

Unleash all the pent-up rage from daily life and go beast mode against your enemies in this Multiplayer Arena Brawler featuring Kaijus and Heroes. Choose from a colorful cast of Tokusatsu-inspired Titans, each with their own playstyle and moveset to master.

[previewyoutube=kJUeC8NqQqo;full][/previewyoutube]

Battle with up to 4 players in fully-destructible maps, each with its own surprise mechanic to be discovered. Gather Giga Energy as you fight and dominate your foes by transforming into an S-Class Titan, or utterly humiliate them all by unleashing an over-the-top Ultimate.

[h3][b]Couch Play & Online Mode[/b][/h3]
Enjoy the game with up to 4 friends in Couch Play or climb up the global dominance hierarchy in Online Mode.

[h3][b]Mayhem Mode[/b][/h3]
Switch up the pacing with Mayhem Mode, a party game mode featuring a collection of wacky minigames that newcomers and seasoned veterans can enjoy together.

[h3][b]Story Mode[/b][/h3]
Discover the origins (and misadventures) of the Titans in four unique single-player campaigns, each with its own oversized protagonist. Explore all the collectible lore and piece together the mystery of the game’s narrative universe.

[h3][b][i]Crack your knuckles and sharpen those claws, Titans! It’s time to GigaBash! [/i][/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1546400/GigaBash/

notes.title: GigaBash Demo - Thank You!
notes.content:
[h2]Thank you everyone for playing the demo! We hope you had a [b]Gigaaaaa BLAAAAST![/b]ːsteamhappyː[/h2]

Steam Next Fest was an avalanche of emotions filled with surprises and crazy moments. We released a [b]Free Demo[/b] to the world and managed to squeeze in the all-new Mayhem Mode, which offers a quick sample of the various wacky minigames that will come together with the base game! Compared to our closed-Alpha, we also included new maps into Battle Mode for everyone to try out. We hope you got a taste of them all!

We were flooded with joy when we saw players streaming the game on Twitch. We also saw lots of GigaBash videos popping up on YouTube along with the various discussions everyone had on social media. It really motivates us to keep pushing forward. We’re glad the game brought you so much joy too and thanks for sharing your laughs with us!

We will continue to work on the game and iron out the bugs as we approach launch. We’d love to know what you think about the Demo, so in case you haven’t done so...
